newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly higher on lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly higher on lower turnover.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mostly higher on Tuesday on lower turnover.
* Eight of 13 active issues rose, two fell and two were unchanged.
* Volume slightly down at 14,049 shares, turnover halved at 5.8 million kuna.
* Top gainer Zagrebacka Banka's C-series bearer shares rose 50 kuna to 550, with 11 units sold.
* Biggest decliner Privredna Banka lost 100 kuna to 150, trading 100 shares in a first deal since mid-December.
* Most active food processor Podravka edged up 10 kuna to 282 on volume of 7,765 units. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
